propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, but pops the forward entry unconditionally, creating orphaned reverse keys that survive indefinitely.

Stranded reverse index keys without corresponding forward entries are reported forever by bridge fsck as store_integrity violations of kind reverse_missing_forward, masking genuine future integrity problems.

The forward-entry jira_key guard in unbind() is safe only by whole-file invariant, not by its own logic, making the method vulnerable to orphans from merge artifacts or out-of-band forward entry deletion.
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair command with pre-write guards is needed to prune orphaned reverse keys through the public BindingStore API without reaching into _data.
unbind() can be fixed to be self-contained by adding a sweep of the reverse index after the keyed pop, clearing any residual reverse[K] == local_id regardless of whether the forward entry exists.
